headline: Warming makes the strongest tropical cyclones and their rainfall more hazardous, but the evidence does not support saying that global tropical-cyclone counts must increase.

projected_response_at_2c_anthropogenic_w.note: positive median response; individual studies span a wider range

additional_hazard: Sea-level rise increases coastal inundation reached by a given storm surge even without a change in storm meteorology.
not_supported: A claim that the total number of tropical cyclones globally will increase.
Attributing any individual storm to climate change without a dedicated event-attribution study.
Using storm damage trends as a pure physical climate metric without normalizing for exposure, wealth, construction, and protection.
